title: Temporal Extrapolation of Elastic Seismic Wave Propagation in Layered Media Using Neural Operators
abstract: arXiv:2611.25130v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Temporal prediction of seismic velocity fields beyond the time interval represented in training remains challenging for neural operator models. This study develops a coupled neural operator framework for stress-conditioned temporal prediction in layered elastic media. A time-integrator-embedded Deep Operator Network (TI-DeepONet) advances the velocity field through an embedded fourth-order Runge-Kutta (RK4) scheme, while a Fourier Neural Operator (FNO) learns a residual correction to the predicted spatial field. The two components are trained jointly in a predictor-corrector configuration. Prediction is initialized with reference velocity fields at the first two time levels and proceeds autoregressively, with reference stress fields and prescribed excitation supplied throughout rollout, including beyond the training interval. translated_title: 基于神经算子的层状介质弹性地震波传播时间外推
translated_abstract: 对于神经算子模型而言，对超出训练时间区间的地震速度场进行时间预测仍然具有挑战性。本研究开发了一个耦合神经算子框架，用于层状弹性介质中应力条件化的时间预测。嵌入时间积分器的深度算子网络通过嵌入的四阶龙格-库塔格式推进速度场，而傅里叶神经算子学习对预测空间场的残差校正。这两个组件以预测-校正器的配置进行联合训练。预测以前两个时间层的参考速度场初始化，并以自回归方式推进，在整个滚动预测过程中持续提供参考应力场和规定的激励，包括超出训练区间的部分。四个案例考虑了固定总深度的四层土柱中的水平极化剪切波……
tldr: 该论文提出将嵌入RK4时间积分器的DeepONet与FNO残差校正以预测-校正器方式耦合训练，实现了层状弹性介质中地震波速度场超出训练时间区间的自回归时间外推预测。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a coupled predictor-corrector neural operator framework that combines an RK4 time-integrator-embedded DeepONet with an FNO residual corrector to enable autoregressive temporal extrapolation of seismic wave velocity fields beyond the training time interval in layered elastic media.
